source.title: Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1936, p. 4 ("Lurgan Rural Council")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text, which is clean; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1936: one change and no contest. Returned unopposed. The report lists the members without their divisions; division assigned from the 1930 and 1933 lists. J. G. Gracey: no party label printed in 1936. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1933, printed 'U': Lurgan Mail, 29 April 1933, p. 3 ("County and Rural Council Elections"); Kernan, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1936, printed 'U': Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1936, p. 4 ("Local Government Nominations: Armagh County Council"); Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1936, p. 6 ("The Elections"); Kernan, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1939, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections")).
